mapper.select: SELECT b.building_id AS buildingId, b.community_id AS communityId, c.community_name AS communityName, c.address_line AS communityAddress, b.building_no AS buildingNo, b.building_name AS buildingName, b.longitude, b.latitude FROM building b INNER JOIN community c ON c.community_id = b.community_id WHERE b.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.community_id, b.building_id
mapper.update: UPDATE building SET longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude}, location_source = 'AMAP' WHERE building_id = #{buildingId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (longitude IS NULL OR latitude IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT b.community_id AS communityId, c.community_name AS communityName, b.building_id AS buildingId, b.building_no AS buildingNo, b.building_name AS buildingName, b.longitude, b.latitude FROM building b INNER JOIN community c ON c.community_id = b.community_id WHERE b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.longitude IS NOT NULL AND b.latitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.community_id, b.building_id

SELECT c.community_id AS communityId, AVG(b.longitude) AS longitude, AVG(b.latitude) AS latitude FROM community c INNER JOIN building b ON b.community_id = c.community_id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.longitude IS NOT NULL AND b.latitude IS NOT NULL WHERE c.longitude IS NULL OR c.latitude IS NULL GROUP BY c.community_id
mapper.update: UPDATE community SET longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude}, location_source = 'AMAP', coordinate_system = 'GCJ02' WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND (longitude IS NULL OR latitude IS NULL)
